headline: Ukraine's Ministry of Finance publishes presentation on draft state budget for 2027
summary: The Finance Ministry presented the draft 2027 state budget, in which over 44% of revenues, or UAH 2,493 billion ($55 billion), are to come from foreign loans and grants.
why: The state budget sets government spending and borrowing needs, and reliance on external financing affects Ukraine's sovereign credit and currency outlook.
